placeName.zh-CN: 阿根廷布宜诺斯艾利斯

details.direction: Palermo → Recoleta → Obelisco → Puerto Madero → La Boca → Palermo (loop)
details.distanceMethod: Official 2026 regulations: 42.195 km on an urban asphalt circuit homologated by World Athletics. No per-kilometre official split table or GPX was published; the official course map is an image still named Recorrido-42K-2024.jpg and is treated as a course-shape reference, not 2026-specific geometry. Media descriptions of the landmarks match that map, but the organiser has not confirmed that the 2026 route is metre-for-metre identical.
details.attribution: Maratón de Buenos Aires. The official page displays a 2024 course-map image without a separate 2026 map or a GPX; the image is linked, not re-hosted.
